Page.title: About & Contact
Page.description: Call or email Ajared Research Inc. in Toronto (+1 613 661 3550) or Abuja (+234 805 064 4454). An applied research and product studio that solves real business problems and builds data products and information systems for enterprises.

Header.Description: Who we are, how we work, and how to reach us in Toronto and Abuja.

Actions.Lead: Have a project in mind? Tell us about it. We reply within 48–72 hours.

About.Purpose: Make things better by making better things.

Intro.P: Ajared Research Inc. is an applied research and product studio. We solve real business problems, and build data products and information systems for enterprises.

We help founders, small, and medium enterprises across North America and Nigeria apply AI and data to improve real products or workflows. Over the long run we are building a platform of intelligent products and systems for cities.

Group.title: Core Values
Group.Item: Simple is not easy, but it is still useful.
Curious, always learning, improving through tiny experiments.
We keep our commitments, and renegotiate early when we need to.
A possibility mentality, plus discipline and capacity building.

Group.title: Why Ajared
Group.P: We deliver practical value: what is actually useful, by cutting out the fluff, and taking ownership end-to-end with a diverse team.

Group.title: The Ajared Way
Group.Item: A free readiness check of your business, data and technology, with an action plan.
A 30-minute conversation with a practitioner about fit and priorities.
A PRD, user journeys and flows, so everyone knows what is being built.
We build and ship in four weeks.
Learnings, embedded tools and systems, and a roadmap forward.
